messages:
oncall-bot Incident alert: router tail latency spike detected across us-east-1 + ap-south-1. p99 > 12s, streaming stalls seen. Paging oncall: @alex.

alex I’m on it — pulling traces and SLO dashboard now. Can you drop quick customer impact (prod-facing streams / number of requests)? :rotating_light:

maya seeing a correlated increase in LB misroute errors, weight prop failures in the routing-policy service. Hot partitions on shard-42 and shard-128.

sam any deploys recently to routing-policy? I see a seed-rollout this morning but it was flagged green.

lee deploys: #policy-seed v3.9.1 -> rolled at 09:18 UTC to 30% canary, then 100% at 10:05. No obvious revert recorded.

jordan I’m dumping router logs for us-east-1 now:
```
EPOCH=3315001234 route_assign: policy_seed=0x7f4a mismatch -> fallback used
WARN: weight_propagation timeout for shard=42; fallback_count=12
STREAM: connection stall after 7s, client_id=svc-logger-57
```

alex interesting — fallback_count increasing implies LB tried alternate shards. That could explain tail. Any hotkeys reported?

maya yes hotkey heatmap spiking on user-session-ids (long streaming sessions) — these sessions get bounced around after fallback which rehydrates KV cache repeatedly. p95 also creeping up to 850ms, p99 sky high.

ops-bot Auto-scaling triggered: Dedicated pool us-east-1 GPUs +2 (cooldown).

alex ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause policy-seed rollout (if still active) 2) pin router to previous stable seed in us-east-1 3) enable sticky affinity for streaming routes 4) divert new streaming traffic to fallback region temporarily. Can someone run the seed rollback?

lee rolling rollback now for us-east-1 and ap-south-1 to policy-seed v3.9.0. Running: `make infra-rollback env=us-east-1 service=routing-policy seed=v3.9.0`

sam confirm: I see rollback started, pushing config push to routers. ETA ~ 90s for propagation.

eng-sre-bot Livepager: @alex -> @maya -> @sam acknowledged. Oncall handoff queued.

alex while rollback in flight, can we also increase sticky-affinity TTL for streaming endpoints from 30s -> 5m? That should reduce churn across shards.

jordan we can push a router config override:
```
route.sticky_affinity.ttl=300
route.fallback_threshold=5
```
Applying to us-east-1 now.

maya routing table snapshot (pre-rollback):
- shard-42: load 4.8x baseline
- shard-128: load 3.2x baseline
- top 10 keys concentrated at 78% of active streams

cs-rep Notifying customers in impacted region: sending proactive message to top 10 customers with long-running streams. No SLA credits yet, monitoring.

alex rollback completed in us-east-1, propagation looks good. Telemetry shows p99 dropping from ~12s -> ~3.1s over last 2m. ap-south-1 rollback still ongoing.

sam ap-south-1 rollback finished. Early indicators: streaming stalls reduced, KV cache hit ratio improving. p95 back to ~420ms, p99 ~2.8s.

ops-bot Canary reroute disabled. Automatic fallback policy set to conservative mode.

maya root cause hypothesis: v3.9.1 changed weight propagation to propagate partial updates asynchronously. Under hot partitioning this caused inconsistent shard weights for a short window, LB would misroute then routers invoked fallback aggressively, which rehydrated KV caches and caused streaming stalls.

alex good summary. Next actions: a) create postmortem checklists b) add integration test for weight-propagation race under hotkey load c) consider backoff before fallback ramp to avoid KV thrash.

jordan capturing logs + trace IDs for two representative long-streams, attaching to the incident. (links)

mia (not in thread) quick Q: any customer-visible errors besides latency? timeouts?

maya some clients saw transient HTTP 504s during the worst window when stall > 20s, but most recovered via retry.

cs-rep drafting customer incident note: summary + mitigation + timeline + next steps. Will request follow-up with affected accounts.

alex assign action owners:
- rollout process & canary checks: lee + sam
- routing-policy code fix (weight-propagation): maya + jordan
- sticky-affinity opt and throttling: alex + eng-sre bot follow-up
- postmortem & customer comms: cs-rep + tia

tia I’ll schedule a 1.5h postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC and include SLAs/impact slide.

eng-sre-bot Regression test task created: INF-2387 weight-propagation under hotkeys.

alex final note: keep this thread for live mitigation logs only. Move postmortem write-up to #postmortems after incident is stable. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot Incident resolved: latency SLOs recovered to normal. p95/p99 within targets for last 10m. Incident duration ~ 42m.

cs-rep Will send customers the initial notification within 30m and include mitigation steps.

alex logging timeline and snippets into the incident ticket. Closing channel in 1h unless we see regressions.
